newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-S&P says TNT on positive creditwatch.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-S&P says TNT on positive creditwatch.

text.p: Standard and Poor's Corp said on Wednesday that it had placed TNT Ltd on creditwatch positive.

S&P said it had placed TNT's B-plus long term credit rating of TNT on creditwatch with positive implications, following the announcement of the intended purchase of teh company by Koninklijke PTT Nederland NV (KPN).
The rating agency said the creditwatch status would remain until the acquistion is completed. Completion of the transaction will result in TNT's rating being equalised with KPN's.
KPN has a AA-plus long term credit rating.

"Before the creditWatch placement, the (TNT) rating outlook had been positive, reflecting expectations that the company's restructuring efforts would eventually lead to an improvement in earnings," S&P said.
